clue.text: Quick courses for production of crops

definitions.meaning: quicker routes taken to get somewhere, missing out the long way round
a crop is a closely cut hairstyle, so producing crops means cutting hair close

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: faster routes that save distance, and hair trimmed close to the head in a crop.

clue.text: Southern border plant

parts.note: an edge is a border or margin

explanation.surface: A plant grows along a border in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedge is a grass-like plant growing in wet ground.

clue.text: Comply with notice

definitions.meaning: to keep to or follow a rule or custom

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to keep a law or custom, and to watch or spot.

clue.text: Pain from hatchet blow across middle of foot

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are placed across, on either side of, the central letters
blow is used as a verb of ruin, scattering the letters of hatchet
the middle of the word foot is its two central letters

explanation.surface: A hatchet blow across the middle of the foot really hurts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blow' rearranges HATCHET into T...THACHE, which goes 'across' OO, the middle of FOOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Toothache is an ache in a tooth, a common pain.

clue.text: Peacemakers land to capture rising revolutionary in clandestine group

indicators.note: one piece takes another prisoner, holding it within

parts.note: the UN, the United Nations, keeps the peace
ground is land or soil

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a red is a revolutionary socialist or communist

explanation.surface: UN peacekeepers land to arrest a rebel in an underground cell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns RED into DER, which UN GROUND captures.
explanation.definitionFit: The underground is a secret resistance movement working in hiding.

clue.text: Thus money is used to bribe

parts.note: so means thus, in this way
P is short for penny or pence, a little money

explanation.surface: So money is what greases palms.
explanation.definitionFit: A sop is a small gift or concession given to placate or buy someone off.

clue.text: Cloaks inspiring many copies

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword shorthand for many
to ape someone is to copy or imitate them

explanation.surface: A fashion for cloaks sets off a wave of imitations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspiring' serves only as a loose link, the hundred leading the imitations; C stands in front of APES.
explanation.definitionFit: A cape is a sleeveless outer garment hung from the shoulders, a kind of cloak.

clue.text: Flier getting new award

parts.note: a crow is a bird, something that flies

explanation.surface: A pilot receives a new award.
explanation.definitionFit: A crown is given as a mark of victory or honour, as a champion's title.

clue.text: American currency appreciates — use it to acquire a stock issue

indicators.note: one piece takes another into itself, holding it inside

parts.note: the peso is the currency of several Latin American countries
something that appreciates goes up in value

explanation.surface: Investors use a rising dollar to buy shares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stock issue' is not about shares: soup is what a pot of stock gives. The peso is used in Latin America, so 'American' needs no 'US'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pea soup is a thick broth made with stock, something a pot of stock produces.

clue.text: The cheese used by a shrewd bowler

parts.note: sage means wise or shrewd
a derby is the American name for a bowler hat

explanation.surface: A clever cricket bowler has a favourite cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bowler' suggests cricket, but it is the hat. Sage Derby is an English cheese flavoured with sage.
explanation.definitionFit: This English cheese is marbled green with the herb, a named variety of hard cheese.

clue.text: Friction when dance centre introduced to thoroughfare

indicators.note: the dance place is introduced to the road by being put in front of it

parts.note: a disco is a club or hall where people go to dance
RD is the abbreviation for road, a thoroughfare

explanation.surface: A new dance club on the main road causes friction with the neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: Discord is conflict or disagreement, the friction between people who clash.

clue.text: Surgical instrument needed for professional report

parts.note: pro is the short form of professional
a report is a loud noise such as a gunshot, a bang

explanation.surface: A surgeon's tool is needed to file a professional report.
explanation.definitionFit: A probang is a slender rod with a sponge on its end used to clear or treat the throat.

clue.text: World heading off shortage

indicators.note: the first letter, the head, of the word for shortage is cut off

parts.note: a dearth is a scarcity or lack of something

explanation.surface: The world is warding off a shortage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' reads as preventing, but it drops the D from DEARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is our planet, the world we live on.

clue.text: Outlaw likely to mug wearing balaclava?

parts.note: to mug someone is to rob them
dressed in a garment is wearing it
a balaclava is a knitted hood covering the head

explanation.surface: A bandit in a balaclava looks ready to mug passers-by.
explanation.walkthrough: Robin Hood is the legendary English outlaw of Sherwood Forest who robbed the rich.
explanation.definitionFit: The folk hero of English ballads lived outside the law in the forest, the archetypal bandit.

clue.text: Reserve reaping machines for those gathering leaves in volume .

parts.note: to book is to reserve a seat or table
a binder is a harvesting machine that cuts and ties sheaves

explanation.surface: Farmers book harvesters to gather a big crop of leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: The leaves are pages, gathered into a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Binders of books stitch pages together and put them into covers to make a volume.

clue.text: Colour of stamp is announced

indicators.note: said out loud, the word for a stamping tool is heard

parts.note: a die is a tool for stamping a design onto metal or coins

explanation.surface: Someone asks what colour a postage stamp is.
explanation.definitionFit: A dye is a colouring substance; as a noun or verb it means to colour.

clue.text: Performance involving cast one's understudied

indicators.note: one piece contains the others within it

parts.note: a deed is an act or performance
to put, as in putting the shot, is to throw or cast
I is one, and I'S stands for one's or one is

explanation.surface: In a show involving a cast, one stood in for the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks theatrical but means throw, as in putting the shot; 'one's' is read as 'one is'.
explanation.definitionFit: To deputise is to stand in for someone, as an understudy does for an actor.

clue.text: It provides duplicates from a set of keys

definitions.text: It provides duplicates from a set of keys

parts.words: It provides duplicates from a set of keys
parts.note: looks like a locksmith cutting spare keys, but the keys are those of a typewriter, and the copy comes from a coated sheet under the top page

explanation.surface: A locksmith cuts spare copies of house keys.
explanation.definitionFit: This inked sheet placed between pages makes a copy of whatever is typed on the keyboard.

clue.text: Create an opening for repeat broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are strewn into a new order

explanation.surface: A TV channel makes a slot for a repeat broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like television but rearranges FOR REPEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: To perforate is to pierce or punch a hole through something.

clue.text: Curious aiming point for picture

indicators.note: curious means odd or strange, so the letters come out oddly ordered

parts.note: E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A curious target point is pictured.
explanation.definitionFit: To imagine is to form a mental picture of something.

clue.text: Cook little fish

definitions.meaning: to cook something in hot fat in a pan

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to cook in a pan of hot oil, and very young fish just hatched.

clue.text: Fine on London borough reported sensation!

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils

indicators.note: said aloud, the name of the place is heard

parts.note: Ealing is a borough of west London

explanation.surface: A fine imposed on a London borough causes a stir.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeling is a physical sensation or an emotion.

clue.text: Awful display of greed at an outdoor restaurant

indicators.note: the letters of the words are displayed in an awful jumbled order

explanation.surface: Diners behave greedily at an al fresco café.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awful display of' rearranges GREED AT AN.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea garden is an open-air café serving tea and refreshments.

clue.text: Simpleton circling motorway is off course

indicators.note: going round, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: an ass is a fool or simpleton
the M1 is Britain's first main motorway, London to Leeds, written MI

explanation.surface: A fool driving round a motorway goes the wrong way.
explanation.definitionFit: Amiss means wrong or astray, gone off the right course.

clue.text: It's concealed without opening, that's obvious

indicators.note: the opening, or first letter, of the word for concealed is lost

parts.note: covert means secret or hidden

explanation.surface: Something hidden without a way in is plain to see.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the C from COVERT turns a word for hidden into its opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and plainly visible, the opposite of secret.

clue.text: His notes make sense

parts.note: a singer whose notes are pitched high among men, and also the gist or general sense of what is said

explanation.definitionFit: The high male singing voice, and also the drift or meaning of a speech.

clue.text: Squadron leader unwell but making progress in the main

indicators.note: the leader of the word squadron is its first letter

parts.note: ailing means sick or poorly

explanation.surface: An ill squadron leader nevertheless gets on with things at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is the open sea, an old poetic term.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailing is travelling across water by ship, moving forward on the open sea.

clue.text: Article held by doctor making incision

indicators.note: kept inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A doctor makes an incision.
explanation.definitionFit: A gap is an opening or break, like the slit an incision leaves.

clue.text: Delight when first story is read back

indicators.note: the pieces are read in reverse order, from back to front

parts.note: No 1 is a way of writing first
a tale is a story

explanation.walkthrough: NO I plus TALE gives NOITALE, which 'read back' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: Elation is great happiness and exhilaration, a feeling of delight.

clue.text: Put in order for outfit

definitions.meaning: to arrange or align, as soldiers ... their ranks
a set of clothes, a frock

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to align troops in proper order, and a garment or set of clothes.

clue.text: Once-wild pigeon accepted by a carrier?

definitions.meaning: a North American bird now extinct, once flying wild in huge flocks
someone taken aboard an airline, bus or ship as a traveller

explanation.surface: A former wild pigeon is now taken in as a carrier pigeon.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the extinct North American pigeon of that name, and a traveller carried by a vehicle.
